commits.message: Refactor text elements in SearchRouteScreen and CommissionPendingModal for improved clarity and consistency. Update distance display formatting and enhance messaging regarding unpaid commissions and account status.

Enhance route management by adding optional quartierName to RoutePoint and pickupQuartier to search parameters in SearchRoute. Improve ShareRouteScreen with payment summary handling and alert for blocked accounts. Update NewRoute to filter trips based on pending requests and account status. Refactor mappers for better trip pricing calculations and integrate new distance metrics for driver routes.

Refactor trip management components to enhance passenger status handling and improve user experience. Update DriverTripsScreen to count completed trips, add optional comment functionality in ReportPassengerScreen, and implement vehicle filtering in SearchRouteScreen. Enhance ShareRouteScreen with dynamic pricing calculations based on vehicle type and streamline route search functionality. Integrate new modal for commission payments in HomeScreen and NewRoute components, ensuring consistent user interactions across the app.

Enhance user review functionality across multiple components by integrating touchable elements for driver ratings and reviews. Update reporting features to include new reasons for passenger issues and improve the handling of non-completed trips. Refactor rating submission process to allow optional comments and streamline user experience in settings and trip management screens.

Refactor sign-up and edit profile components for improved code readability. Update default country selection in sign-up to Mali and enhance gender handling in edit profile. Implement new passenger reporting functionality in trip management, including inline rating options and improved error handling in report submissions. Integrate Google Maps API for route calculations and enhance UI elements across various screens for better user experience.

Refactor ActiveTrip, Notifications, Report, ShareRoute, and NewRoute components for improved code readability and consistency. Enhance user experience by updating alert messages and UI elements, and reorganizing imports. Implement minor layout adjustments and ensure better handling of trip details and passenger information.

Update app configuration to include new permissions for location services and enhance dependency management by adding 'burnt' and 'expo-location' packages. Refactor recent trips and search route components for improved user experience, including better handling of trip details and location display names.

Enhance app configuration and user experience by integrating Google Maps API keys for both iOS and Android platforms. Update dependencies to include a new datetime picker component and improve vehicle management in the Manage Vehicle screen. Refactor notifications and payment screens for better UI consistency and functionality, including dynamic pricing calculations and improved trip rating features.

Refactor authentication flow and enhance user experience. Integrated user state management in RootLayout, updated sign-in and sign-up components to trigger authentication refresh, and improved navigation handling. Added loading states and error handling in recent trips and settings screens, while optimizing vehicle management and trip details presentation.

Implement user authentication flow and enhance navigation structure. Added user state management in RootLayout, integrated user retrieval on app load, and updated sign-in component to handle authentication with feedback. Refactored route management in SearchRoute and improved UI consistency across various components.

Enhance sign-up process by integrating OTP verification with email registration. Updated auth-client to include gender in the sign-up request. Minor UI adjustments in input component for better styling consistency.

Update app configuration and dependencies; remove unused components and files. Added bundle identifier for iOS, integrated new libraries for maps and authentication, and modified scripts for running the app. Cleaned up the project by deleting obsolete components and layout files.
